sender.description: Sender of the own transfer. Represents information about the origin of the transfer which, in the case of a own transfer, could be only a product

contract.description: Contract benefactor of the own transfer. It refers to the contract from which the charge over a certain amount is transferred to a recipient, in the case of a mobile transfer: an account or card.

contractId.description: Corresponds with the identifier of a contract. It should be a code that identifies univocally a contract.

number.description: Contract number. This number consists in an alpha-numerical sequence to identify a specific hired product. It should be used only in the absence of the unique identifier

receiver.description: Receiver of the own transfer. Represents information about the destination of the transfer which, in the case of a own transfer, could be only a product that belongs to the same customer that performs the transfer

contract.description: Recipient contract of the own transfer. It refers to the contract that receives the amount transferred, such an account, card, pension fund, mutual fund, etc.

contractId.description: Corresponds with the identifier of a contract from where the mobile transfer will be send. It should be a code that identifies univocally a contract. In the case of using this unique identifier, field \'number\' should not be used and it will be ignored

number.description: Contract number. This number consists in an alpha-numerical sequence to identify a specific hired product. It should be used only in the absence of the unique identifier

currency.description: String based on ISO-4217 for specifying the currency related to the transfer monetary amount.

isMajor.description: Flag indicating whether this currency corresponds to the main currency.
